findings.title: Approved thawing methods used.
findings.comment: Inspector observed raw ground beef thawing at room temperature on the counter in the kitchen. PIC was informed that ground beef needs to be thawed either under running water in a sink or under refrigeration. Raw beef measured 40F on the counter and was placed back in the cooler during the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.13(A) Thawing. Except as specified in (D) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be thawed: (A) Under refrigeration that maintains the FOOD temperature at 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed employee put on new pair of gloves without first washing hands. Wash hand before each new glove use. Discussed proper hand washing technique and glove use with PIC.

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels available for use at bar hand washing sink. Paper towels were provided during inspection. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed spoon and plastic containers in basin of kitchen hand sink. Items were removed during inspection. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed nozzle of soda gun at bar to be soiled with debris. Clean and sanitize soda gun nozzle. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed container of chili in cooler to have a date mark of 10/8. Chili was discarded during inspection. 

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed wet mop head to be stored head down in mop bucket. Store wet mop head in a fashion that promotes quick drying. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior cavity of kitchen microwave to be soiled with food splash and debris. Clean and sanitize interior cavity of microwave. 

4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior of ice machine to be soiled with debris. Clean and sanitize interior of ice machine. 

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Observed unlabeled spray bottle of brown liquid in kitchen. Bottle was labeled as fryer cleaner during inspection. 

7-102.11: Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Approved thawing methods used
findings.comment:
Observed frozen chicken being thawed in three compartment sink with no running water. Observed ziploc bag of ham being thawed in water in kitchen. Both items were placed under running water to thaw during inspection. 

3-501.13: TCS FOOD shall be thawed: (A) at 41F or below in refrigeration (B) completely submerged under running water, not getting above 41F (water temp of 70F or below). If food will be cooked, not getting above 41F for more than 4 hours. (C) part of the cooking process (D) Using any procedure if RTE FOOD is thawed and prepared for immediate service (E) ROP FISH that bear label shall be removed from packaging before thawing under refrigeration, upon completion of thawing from running water.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizing solution available for use during food preparation and service. Sanitizing solution was made during inspection and tested at 200 ppm Cl-.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. 
(B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the ice machine to be soiled with mold. Ice machine was turned off and cleaned and sanitized during inspection.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed cheese sauce at 120F and chili at 124F in the hot holding unit. Foods were discarded in the garbage.
3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed sliced tomato on the hamburger topping rail to be 50F. Tomato slices were discarded. Make sure to plug all holes in the rail for best function of the unit. 
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: Observed an area on the floor in the storage room to be missing tile from the removal of a wall. Repair or replace flooring material so that dirt and debris do not collect in this area. 6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: Observed an ashtray that is soiled to be stored on top of the open box of single service salt shakers and between ice coffee mix and other spices.  There is also a stock of can cozies behind the box of salt and ash tray next to the other food items. The cozies and ash tray were removed. 750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: There is no supply of hand towels in the men's restroom. Provide hand towels to the holder. 750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment: Observed a purse, personal cookie sheet and bag of personal articles to be sitting on the counter in the kitchen area.  Store personal items separate from kitchen and food areas. The purse and other items went home wih the bartender. 750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: There was birthday party yesterday and the party thrower left a crock pot at the facility according to management. The facility was informed that if food not in accordance with their permit was left on premise it would be a critical violation. The crock pot is clean and the owner said that he thinks the owners will get it today. 750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.citation_text:
750.290 - Ice scoop was observed sitting on a cloth towel on top of the ice machine. Scoop was placed in the ice machine with the handle extended up out of ice.

Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.citation_text:
750.820 - Concentration of sanitizer at 3 part sink was less than 200ppm quat. Effective concentration is 200-400ppm. Solution was made around 11a with only one tablet. Solution was remade with two tablets and tested at proper concentration of 200ppm. Make sure all staff know how many tablets to use and how to check the concentration with test strips.

Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) pizza oven - tray and drip tray (food debris);   and
B) inside ice machine (mold).

Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris. For in-use items such as pizza slicer must go through wash, rinse, and sanitize process up to every 4 hours after continuous use.
Also, clean and sanitize the soda gun and holder as needed.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text:
750.880 - Single service items (plates & bowls) on top of fridge were stored with food surfaces exposed. Discussed storage of items inverted on a clean surface or in a clean storage container. 

Single service articles shall be stored, handles, and dispensed in a manner that protects items from potential contamination.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text:
750.880 - A) Packages of coffee filters, straws, and stirs were observed in cabinet below 3pt sink beneath plumbing. Single service articles were moved to opposite end of cabinet (no longer directly under plumbing).
B) Unwrapped straws are used at the facility. Obtain a pair of small tongs  for handling straws when making drinks or purchase wrapped straws.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.citation_text: 750.1300 - Spray bottle under kitchen sink had worn label. Employee was unsure as to the contents. Chemical was discarded. Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for operational maintenance shall be prominently and distinctly labeled. Maintain proper labels on all spray bottles.
